description: Single-DGX-Spark Swift 1.5 (UkisAI's reasoning-efficient Qwen3.8 Flash Next derivative) as its NVFP4 checkpoint (186.4 GB: FP4 routed experts, BF16 elsewhere, BF16 PLE n-gram table) on tournierjc's TensorFold fork (branch integration/0.6.4 at 53ceb126: TensorFold v0.6.4 plus the rig's changes, among them the 8-bit decode faces and the 80,014-id MTP draft vocabulary; Apache-2.0; exact drafting, custom CUDA kernels JIT-compiled on first start). Follows tournierjc's single-Spark rig (70c56139, MIT), which pins that fork commit in its Dockerfile (TF_REPO, TF_REF) and runs three lanes of the full 262,144-token window with int8 KV, image and video input (--vision, which needs at least two lanes), MTP confidence 0.60, TENSORFOLD_FACES_FP8=all and a 1,280 MiB vision workspace reserve; replies without max_tokens get up to 32,768 tokens. Upstream measured on one Spark with the complete checkpoint: a startup estimate of 98.31 GiB within a 104.44 GiB budget, about 214 s to load, three streams sustaining 111.6 tok/s aggregate against 42.1 for one (upstream figures, unmeasured here). The 8-bit faces trade precision for speed (upstream notes the copy answers the stored rows within 15% and the draft head accepted 48% instead of 64% in its author's measurement); they are the kit's configuration. The n-gram table (95.4 GiB) is memory-mapped and paged from disk, so keep the model on NVMe; --ple-on-ssd is refused for an NVFP4 checkpoint and is not used. Licences (information only): the Swift contribution is under the Swift Open License v1.0 (free up to US$1M gross annual revenue including affiliates, above that a separate Swift Enterprise License from UkisAI); the Qwen3.8 Flash Next base terms still apply under the Qwen Community License 1.0 (model name displayed above 100M MAU or US$20M monthly revenue; separate licence for Model-as-a-Service or AI Work Assistant businesses). Thinking is chosen per request (chat template kwargs or sampling parameters), not as a recipe option; server default: thinking on with reasoning effort xhigh (the kit's setting).
title: Swift 1.5 Flash Next NVFP4 TensorFold single Spark
